name: APT42
akas: Charming Kitten, Mint Sandstorm, TA453, Yellow Garuda (Iran, IRGC); CALANQUE ION (GTIG’s Sep 2026 designation)
brief: Used Gemini's text generation/editing to craft phishing material impersonating think-tank staff and for translation/geopolitical research; notably attempted to build a "Data Processing Agent" converting natural-language requests into SQL queries to mine sensitive personal data. GTIG [Update 2026-09] As "CALANQUE ION," continued leveraging Gemini to augment reconnaissance and targeted social engineering, and expanded AI usage to develop tactical infrastructure and attempt reverse-engineering of proprietary software licensing algorithms to bypass security controls/EDR. GTIG
